description: This file defines the class ModifyFeaturePropertiesResponse, which is a response object for the ModifyFeatureProperties command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates details such as the Thing ID, feature ID, optional created feature properties, and HTTP response status. It includes methods for constructing instances from JSON, and for retrieving response data.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesResponse
classes.description: Response class for the ModifyFeatureProperties command, capturing the outcome of the operation such as created or modified feature properties, along with relevant identifiers and response status.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating feature properties were created, marked by HTTP 201 Created.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating feature properties were modified, marked by HTTP 204 No Content.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs the response object from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing relevant fields.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with the response.

methods.name: getFeaturePropertiesCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the newly created feature properties, if any.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON entity representing the feature properties, if present.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON Pointer path to the resource this response pertains to.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
